Can painting fix a damp basement?

No. Painting is a finish, not a solution for water entry or persistent dampness. The moisture source and any damage must be assessed and resolved before suitable dry surfaces are prepared and painted.

Protect flooring and furnishings, clean suitable surfaces, complete agreed minor repairs and prime as required by the surface and coating system.
